# A grid column's explicit id is given to its header button too

## Context

Found while measuring for #18941, promoted from my earlier defect-note. Measured in real Chromium (Playwright e2e rig, dev@7db03e862c) on the fixture `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-cell-editing`, whose pooled grid gives `c3` the id `grid-cell-editing-pooled-c3` (and the small grid gives `city` one).

## The Problem

One id names two instances:

| Read | Answer |
|---|---|
| console at boot | `Trying to create an item with an already existing id`, once per id-carrying column — 2× on every boot of the fixture, so in every `CellEditing*` e2e run |
| `document.getElementById('grid-cell-editing-pooled-c3')` | the header **button** (`button.neo-grid-header-button`, text `C3`) |
| `Neo.worker.App.getConfigs({id: 'grid-cell-editing-pooled-c3', keys: ['className', 'dataField']})` | the **column** (`Neo.grid.column.Base`, `c3`) |

`Neo.logError` writes to the console only, so no `pageerror` gate sees it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/grid/Container.mjs#createColumns` (`:796`): `buttonConfig = {...column}` copies the whole column config — `id` included — into the header button's config, then (`:813–817`) creates the column instance from the same config.
- `src/manager/Base.mjs#register` (`:28–36`) refuses the second registrant of an id and logs; both instances go on living. The column registers first, so `Neo.manager.Instance` holds the column, while `Neo.manager.Component` (where a column never registers) and the DOM hold the button.
- Derived, not measured: `unregister()` removes by key, so destroying the refused instance would drop the first registrant's entry.

No example or app in the repo gives a column an id today; the fixture does, so an arm can reach the column through `setConfigs`.

## The Fix

The header button never takes its column's `id`: strip it from `buttonConfig` in `createColumns`. The column keeps the id the app gave it; the button gets a generated one, like the button of every column without an id.

Arm: the fixture boots with no `already existing id` line in the console, no DOM node carries the column's id, and the id still answers with the column in the App Worker. Red on dev.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A grid whose column carries an explicit `id` boots without the duplicate-id log line.
- [ ] The id resolves to the column in the App Worker, and no DOM node carries it.
- [ ] The arm is red on dev; grid e2e, component and unit tiers stay green.

## Out of Scope

- Whether `manager.Base#register` should throw rather than log.
- Whether `Neo.logError` should reach the `pageerror` gates.

## Avoided Traps

- Deriving a button id from the column's (`<id>__header`): a second naming contract for something no consumer asks for.
